GATE 1 — HITL: pick one use case from ranked shortlist.
Replace this node with a real approval step (e.g. Wait + webhook, or Form Trigger) once you decide the platform's mechanism.
For this sketch: manually pick the top item and continue.

GATE 2 — HITL: approve/edit PRD.
Cheapest place to catch a misread problem before everything downstream compounds it.

GATE 3 — HITL: choose between design variants (not blank-page review).
Taste/internal convention isn't inferable from the PRD alone.

GATE 4 — HITL: pre-deploy approval.
Blast radius gate — anything touching real internal data/workflows needs a human before it's live.
